summary: Reviewed T8/T9 frontend integration, live evidence, README, issue hygiene, and job-log accuracy.
final_report: CHANGES REQUIRED. `app/main.py` registers all `/api` routers before the root `StaticFiles` mount, so API precedence is preserved. `static/app.js` uses only same-origin JSON/fetch SSE calls, stores only the opaque session id in sessionStorage, contains no fixture fallback, and uses textContent/DOM construction for server content. The live T9 evidence is correctly scoped to http://192.168.1.57:8000/, reports `/api/health` as degraded with `endpoint_reachable=false`, and explicitly does not claim successful model generation or SSE; T9's responsive and session checks are useful but the standard verifier and generation remain unverified as documented. README.md describes the root-served UI and API architecture, .gitignore excludes both issue/wants logs, and the T8/T9 provenance and raw line counts match the inspected files. Blocking defect: `static/app.js`'s `api_request()` throws an Error without copying `response.status`, while `bootstrap_session()` only clears an expired stored id when `error.status === 404`; an expired `sage_active_session_id` therefore cannot take the documented stale-session recovery path and leaves the app in an error state. Fix the typed/status-bearing error path and add a stale-session bootstrap test before approval. No production source was modified by this review.
notes: Reviewed actual app/main.py, static/index.html, static/style.css, static/app.js, README.md, T7 research, T8/T9 logs, .gitignore, oc-issues.txt, and oc-wants.txt. Appended issue 11 for the concrete stale-session defect. T9 live evidence remains degraded and is not treated as model/SSE success. No standard verify_ui.mjs run was claimed because T9 records the missing Playwright dependency. Existing unrelated dirty files were left untouched.
